title: Boy with Swim Ring & Family on Beach, 1950 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic post-World War II family snapshot taken in July 1950 capturing a beach outing along the ocean shore. A young boy stands inside a round swim ring on the wet sand, alongside a kneeling woman in a patterned vintage one-piece bathing suit and other family members dressed in mid-century swimwear and summer cover-ups under the bright sun.
